title: Tsunami C To Copy Position
script:
local player = game.Players.LocalPlayer
local mouse = player:GetMouse()

local function copyCoordinates()
    local pos = mouse.Hit.Position
    local text = string.format("X: %.2f, Y: %.2f, Z: %.2f", pos.X, pos.Y, pos.Z)

    setclipboard(text)

    print("Coordinates:", text)
end

mouse.KeyDown:Connect(function(key)
    if key:lower() == "c" then 
        copyCoordinates()
    end
end)


local Notifications = loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tacolift/notification-library/main/library.lua"))()
Notifications.Create("🌊 Tsunami Tools", "Press [C] to copy your mouse position!", 1, Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255))
task.wait(5)
Notifications.Clear()
